hero.heading: PSJA ISD 2026-2027 School Calendar
hero.mobileDescription: Students start Aug. 24 and finish June 2. Winter Break is Dec. 21–Jan. 1, with staff-development days extending students’ time off from Dec. 18 through Jan. 5.
hero.desktopDescription: PSJA ISD’s 2026-2027 school year runs Aug. 24–June 2 with 175 instructional days. Thanksgiving Break is Nov. 23–27, Winter Break is Dec. 21–Jan. 1, and Spring Break is March 15–19. Staff-development days on Dec. 18 and Jan. 4–5 mean students return Jan. 6. editorialSummary.heading: What PSJA ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: First day Monday, August 24, and last day Wednesday, June 2
Winter no-school period runs continuously from December 18 through January 5
February 15 and March 26 appear in both the no-school and Weather Days lists
paragraphs: PSJA ISD’s regular 2026-2027 school year begins Monday, August 24, and ends Wednesday, June 2. The district calendar lists 175 instructional days across six reporting periods. Regular student hours are 8:15 a.m.–3:55 p.m. for elementary schools, 7:45 a.m.–3:25 p.m. for middle schools, and 8:40 a.m.–4:20 p.m. for high schools.

Thanksgiving Break is Nov. 23–27 and Spring Break is March 15–19. The district lists Winter Break as Dec. 21–Jan. 1, but students are also off for staff development on Dec. 18 and Jan. 4–5. So students are off continuously from Dec. 18 through Jan. 5 and return Jan. 6.

Feb. 15 is listed as a Non-School Day and March 26 as Easter Break; both dates also appear under Weather Days. If weather disrupts the school year, families should check district updates before making plans for either date. The calendar also marks enrichment and state-testing dates, but it does not specify grade or subject assignments for the testing dates.

PSJA ISD also schedules enrichment beyond regular instructional days. For the Aug. 3–7 and Aug. 10–14, 2026 camps, the district says the program is free and open to all PSJA ISD students, with transportation, breakfast and lunch provided. The academic calendar marks additional enrichment dates in 2027 but does not publish participation details for those sessions.

statistics.label: Total no-school weekdays
statistics.explanation: Counted from published no-class events between the first and last student days. Weekends and shortened school days are excluded, and overlapping events count once.

statistics.label: Student no-school days
statistics.explanation: Counts weekdays without regular classes outside holidays and multi-day breaks, including staff or planning days. Overlapping entries count once.

statistics.label: Longest listed break
statistics.explanation: Dec 18, 2026–Jan 5, 2027, including weekends. The stretch contains 13 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.

about.processing: The image-based PDF was rendered to check its legend, month grids, reporting periods, bell schedule and event lists. Canonical events keep Winter Break separate from staff-development dates; the continuous winter student no-school stretch appears in breaks. Enrichment and testing ranges include only marked weekday blocks. February 15 and March 26 retain both their published no-school labels and their Weather Days classification; no make-up activation mechanism is inferred. Exempt Fundraiser Days are omitted because this reference focuses on student schedules and family planning.
about.updates: February 15 and March 26 also appear in the Weather Days list. Check district updates if weather affects the published schedule. Enrichment and testing markers do not establish individual student assignments. The academic calendar does not publish graduation ceremony dates or districtwide early-release dates.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by PSJA ISD. Families should confirm weather-day decisions, testing assignments, enrichment participation, graduation schedules, transportation and campus changes directly with the district or their child's school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for PSJA ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first regular student day is Monday, August 24, 2026. The first six-week reporting period begins that day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for PSJA ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last regular student day is Wednesday, June 2, 2027. The sixth reporting period ends that day; June 3–4 are staff workdays.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are on the PSJA ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists 175 instructional days across six reporting periods containing 24, 29, 24, 32, 34 and 32 days.

faqs.question: When is PSJA ISD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is PSJA ISD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Staff-development days on December 18 and January 4–5 extend students' time away from regular classes to December 18–January 5. Classes resume Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: Does PSJA ISD have a Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The published academic calendar does not list a separate Fall Break. September 7 and October 12 are staff-development days with no regular student classes; Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27.

faqs.question: When do PSJA ISD students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. The December 18 and January 4–5 staff-development days extend the continuous no-school period beyond the printed December 21–January 1 Winter Break.

faqs.question: When is PSJA ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Do PSJA ISD students have school on September 7, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. September 7 is a staff-development day and a student no-school day. Classes resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Do PSJA ISD students have school on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. October 12 is a Staff Development Day, with no regular student classes. Classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: When are PSJA ISD staff-development days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: During the regular school year, staff-development days fall on September 7, October 12 and December 18, 2026, plus January 4–5, 2027. Students have no regular classes on those dates.

faqs.question: What are the PSJA ISD weather days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The academic calendar lists February 15 and March 26, 2027, under Weather Days. February 15 is also listed as a Non-School Day, and March 26 as Easter Break. Families should check district updates if weather affects the published schedule.

faqs.question: Does PSJA ISD have school on February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled. The academic calendar lists Monday, February 15, as a Non-School Day and also includes it under Weather Days. Check district updates if weather affects the published schedule.

faqs.question: Does PSJA ISD have school on March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No regular classes are scheduled. The academic calendar lists Friday, March 26, as Easter Break and also includes it under Weather Days. Check district updates if weather affects the published schedule.

faqs.question: Do PSJA ISD students have school on Memorial Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, May 31, is marked as Memorial Day in the non-school-day list. Classes resume June 1.

faqs.question: When do PSJA ISD reporting periods end?
faqs.answer: The six reporting periods end September 25, November 6, December 17, February 19, April 16 and June 2.

faqs.question: What are the regular PSJA ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Student hours are 8:15 a.m.–3:55 p.m. for elementary schools, 7:45 a.m.–3:25 p.m. for middle schools and 8:40 a.m.–4:20 p.m. for high schools.

faqs.question: Does PSJA ISD have early-release days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: No districtwide early-release dates are listed on the 2026-2027 academic calendar. Check your campus calendar for any school-specific schedule changes.

faqs.question: What are PSJA ISD enrichment days?
faqs.answer: Enrichment dates are August 3–7 and August 10–14, 2026; February 27, March 6, April 3, April 10 and April 24, 2027; and June 7–11, June 14–18 and June 21–25, 2027. The academic calendar does not specify participation details for the 2027 enrichment dates.

faqs.question: Do all students attend the August enrichment days?
faqs.answer: The August dates are enrichment camps, not regular districtwide attendance days. PSJA ISD says the camps are free and open to all district students, with registration available through the district. The two August sessions run Aug. 3–7 and Aug. 10–14.

faqs.question: Does PSJA ISD have summer enrichment after the last day?
faqs.answer: Yes. The academic calendar marks June 7–11, June 14–18 and June 21–25, 2027, as Enrichment Days, after the regular school year ends June 2. It does not specify participation details for those dates.

faqs.question: When are the PSJA ISD state-testing windows?
faqs.answer: The calendar marks November 30–December 4, December 7–11, April 5–9, April 12–16, April 19–23, April 26–30, June 14–18 and June 21–25. It does not assign subjects or grades.

faqs.question: Does every student test on every marked state-testing day?
faqs.answer: The academic calendar does not say that every student tests on every marked date. It shows state-testing dates but does not list grades, subjects or individual assignments. Check your child's campus testing information for the dates that apply.

faqs.question: When are PSJA ISD graduations in 2027?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 academic calendar names six campuses for graduation at Bert Ogden Arena but does not list 2027 ceremony dates or times. Check PSJA ISD’s official graduation schedule page for the 2027 schedule when it is published.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official PSJA ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF linked on this page or visit the PSJA ISD district-calendar page for the current academic-calendar file.
